answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 36028 Country: India Title: BEARD PROBLEM? Question: I have beard. I have hair fall problem, the hair of my beard fall here and there. Is there any harm in it according to Islam? Answer ID: 36028 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 130/130/M=1433) Do not let the beard hair to be desecrated. Bury the hair that fell itself in some appropriate place and undergo the treatment of any expert doctor or hakim. Also use any oil to protect your hair. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
